judged_text: removeMember and addMembers call self.findMembers() inside .then without returning it, so a failure of the member-list reload is an unhandled promise rejection that leaves the previously rendered member list in place with no error surfaced. After a successful add/remove, if the follow-up findMembers request fails (network drop, 500), the admin still sees the pre-operation member list — e.g. a removed member still appears after a confirmed removal — with no error dialog; the rejection also propagates as an unhandled promise rejection.
